purpose: Evaluate reproducibility of the PROMIS EHR-only ischemic-stroke D1 and D3 phenotypes after the audited PCORnet-to-OMOP transformation without post-hoc retuning.

shared_source_rules.stroke_definition: Use the exact locked ischemic-stroke ICD code list and all D0 source-reference rules, including PDX == P, EI/IP encounter setting, calendar-day overnight stay, first qualifying encounter ordering, post-index age >=18, and no registry gating/augmentation.
shared_source_rules.imaging_code_system_policy: Procedure code normalized by uppercasing, trimming, and removing decimal points; accepted PCORnet procedure code types are CH, CPT, CPT4, or HCPCS.
shared_source_rules.imaging_window: Procedure date must be between ADMIT_DATE minus 2 calendar days and DISCHARGE_DATE inclusive.
shared_source_rules.lipid_code_policy: Exact trimmed uppercase LOINC membership in the versioned artifact; no prefix, hierarchy, or post-hoc expansion.
shared_source_rules.lipid_date_field_policy: Use the first available source-reference field in the pre-specified order LAB_TKN_DTTM, SPECIMEN_DATE, LAB_DATE, RESULT_DATE, matching the existing PROMIS verification implementation. The preflight records which field is actually available before outcome queries.
shared_source_rules.lipid_window: Lipid evidence date must be between ADMIT_DATE and DISCHARGE_DATE inclusive.
shared_source_rules.evidence_ordering: Imaging and lipid evidence are evaluated for each D0-eligible encounter before patient-level first-event ranking; age is applied after first qualifying D1/D3 encounter selection, matching the existing PROMIS verification implementation.

phenotypes.D1: D0 plus at least one CT-or-MRI procedure in the imaging window and at least one locked lipid LOINC result in the lipid window.
phenotypes.D3: D0 plus at least one MRI procedure in the imaging window and at least one locked lipid LOINC result in the lipid window.

primary_transformation_fidelity.purpose: Test whether the exact source-defined D1/D3 patient cohorts are preserved in frozen OMOP.
primary_transformation_fidelity.policy: Use native OMOP person/visit/condition/procedure/measurement-or-observation rows for transformed facts and dates, with frozen lineage only where exact source-only semantics are required, including PDX and exact source code identity.
primary_transformation_fidelity.one_to_many_policy: A source evidence event is preserved if any of its audited mapped target routes supplies the required phenotype evidence; one-to-many mappings are not treated as duplication failures.
primary_transformation_fidelity.concept_zero_policy: Source evidence that cannot be represented with the required mapped target semantic remains a coverage/representation limitation and is not silently remapped.
primary_transformation_fidelity.source_vocabulary_independence: Exact source-reference lipid eligibility is determined by membership in the locked LOINC artifact, not by whether that LOINC is present and active in the frozen OMOP vocabulary. Frozen-vocabulary absence or deprecation is reported as coverage and must not remove the code from the source-reference phenotype.

secondary_native_portability.purpose: Evaluate D1/D3-like phenotypes expressed with native OMOP Standard concepts only.
secondary_native_portability.stroke_policy: Use the same Standard Condition concept resolution as the D0 portability sensitivity.
secondary_native_portability.imaging_policy: Resolve the locked CPT imaging codes through the frozen vocabulary to active Standard target concepts and preserve valid one-to-many/cross-domain routes.
secondary_native_portability.lipid_policy: Resolve the versioned lipid LOINCs through the frozen vocabulary to active Standard Measurement/Observation concepts; preserve valid one-to-many/cross-domain routes. Locked LOINCs that are absent, deprecated, or lack an allowed active Standard target remain explicit portability-coverage gaps and are not silently remapped.
secondary_native_portability.pdx_limitation: PDX is intentionally absent because it has no native OMOP core equivalent in the frozen build; this sensitivity cannot replace the primary transformation-fidelity estimand.

comparison_metrics: exact index-date agreement among shared patients
discordance decomposition by pre-specified evidence/exclusion category
native-OMOP portable cohort size and overlap as a secondary sensitivity
